PSA: AirPods Max have a wifi flex cable issue that breaks under normal usage. At the end this broken cable will brick your APM. If you can, don’t swivel the metal speaker casing because this action is what ends up breaking the cable. Kinda hard to do knowing that you have to swivel them every time you put them in and take them out of their case. Use a stand to store them if you can. You can repair them, which I’m in the middle of doing now, but it’s not an easy task and if I had know about the issue before buying them I wouldn’t have gotten them.

P.S.
This broken WiFi flex cable issue goes for both APM 1’s and 2’s. Apple did not fix this issue when they made their USB-C version.

A little known accessory - you can buy a lightning to 3.5mm audio cable (specifically made for Airpods Max) that plugs directly into the headphones so you can listen through a wired connection.  An adapter is not needed, just this one cable.  I use it on planes when the screens are built into the seats.

Be aware, this cable comes in 2 variations.  The one for Airpods Max passes audio from a device TO the Airpords Max.  The other variation passes audio FROM an iPhone to a speaker.  They are not interchangeable even though they are both lightning to 35mm jack.
